severe fatigue not relieved by rest: exhausted no matter how much I sleep
morning stiffness: stiff joints when I wake up
rapid heartbeat on standing: heart races when I stand up
tingling numbness in feet hands: pins and needles in hands and feet
post exertional malaise: wiped out the day after exercise

diseases.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
diseases.description_md: Chronic autoimmune disease that can affect skin, joints, kidneys, blood cells, brain and other organs. Course is highly variable and often relapsing-remitting.

features.name: butterfly rash on face
aliases: red patches across cheeks and nose

diseases.name: Hashimoto thyroiditis (autoimmune hypothyroidism)
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune destruction of the thyroid gland causing progressive hypothyroidism. Common in women.

diseases.name: Graves disease (autoimmune hyperthyroidism)
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune over-stimulation of the thyroid causing hyperthyroidism, often with eye involvement.

diseases.name: Celiac disease
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune reaction to dietary gluten that damages the small intestine. Often presents with non-GI features (anemia, fatigue, neurologic).

diseases.name: Crohn disease
diseases.description_md: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease that can affect any part of the GI tract, often with extra-intestinal features.

diseases.name: Ulcerative colitis
diseases.description_md: Chronic inflammatory disease of the colon causing bloody diarrhea and urgency.

diseases.name: Mast cell activation syndrome
diseases.description_md: Episodic systemic release of mast cell mediators triggering flushing, GI symptoms, hypotension, and itching across multiple systems.

diseases.name: Hereditary angioedema
diseases.description_md: Recurrent, painful, non-itchy swelling of skin, gut and airway. Bradykinin-mediated; antihistamines do not help.

features.name: recurrent swelling of face hands feet

diseases.name: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome
diseases.description_md: Sustained heart rate increase on standing without significant blood-pressure drop, with chronic dysautonomic symptoms.

diseases.name: Hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
diseases.description_md: Heritable connective-tissue disorder with joint hypermobility, chronic pain, frequent subluxations, and frequent overlap with POTS and MCAS.

diseases.name: Fibromyalgia
diseases.description_md: Chronic widespread pain syndrome with fatigue, sleep disturbance and cognitive symptoms.

diseases.name: Myalgic encephalomyelitis / chronic fatigue syndrome
diseases.description_md: Severe debilitating fatigue not relieved by rest, with post-exertional malaise lasting more than 24 hours after activity.

features.name: severe fatigue not relieved by rest

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description_md: Recurrent headache disorder with throbbing pain, often unilateral, with photophobia, phonophobia, nausea, and sometimes aura.

features.name: headache triggered by red wine cheese

diseases.name: Multiple sclerosis
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune demyelination of the central nervous system, classically with neurological episodes separated in time and space.

features.name: vision loss in one eye optic neuritis
lhermitte sign electric shock down spine

diseases.name: Behcet disease
diseases.description_md: Multisystem inflammatory disease with recurrent oral and genital ulcers, eye inflammation, and skin lesions.

diseases.name: Ankylosing spondylitis
diseases.description_md: Chronic inflammatory arthritis of the spine and sacroiliac joints, often with extra-articular features.

features.name: lower back pain worse at rest

diseases.name: Rheumatoid arthritis
diseases.description_md: Symmetric inflammatory polyarthritis, typically of small joints of hands and feet, with morning stiffness and elevated inflammatory markers.

features.name: symmetric small joint pain hands feet
morning joint stiffness over one hour

diseases.name: Sjogren syndrome
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune destruction of moisture-producing glands causing dry eyes and dry mouth, with possible systemic features.

diseases.name: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
diseases.description_md: Autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells leading to insulin deficiency.

diseases.name: Addison disease (primary adrenal insufficiency)
diseases.description_md: Insufficient cortisol production by the adrenal glands, often autoimmune. Untreated adrenal crisis is life-threatening.

diseases.name: Cushing syndrome
diseases.description_md: Chronic elevated cortisol producing characteristic somatic and metabolic features.

diseases.name: Pheochromocytoma
diseases.description_md: Catecholamine-secreting tumor of the adrenal medulla causing paroxysmal hypertension and dramatic adrenergic episodes.

diseases.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency
diseases.description_md: Inadequate B12 from autoimmune (pernicious anemia), dietary, or absorption causes — produces hematologic and neurologic features.

diseases.name: Iron deficiency anemia
diseases.description_md: Most common cause of anemia worldwide, frequently from chronic blood loss or malabsorption.

diseases.name: Hereditary hemochromatosis
diseases.description_md: Inherited iron-overload disorder causing organ damage from accumulated iron, often presenting with fatigue, joint pain, and bronze skin.

features.name: joint pain especially second third knuckles

diseases.name: Wilson disease
diseases.description_md: Autosomal-recessive copper accumulation disorder presenting with liver disease and/or movement and psychiatric symptoms in young adults.

diseases.name: Acute intermittent porphyria
diseases.description_md: Heme-biosynthesis disorder causing recurrent attacks of severe abdominal pain, neurologic symptoms, and dark urine.

diseases.name: Familial Mediterranean fever
diseases.description_md: Autoinflammatory disease with recurrent short fevers, sterile peritonitis, pleuritis, and arthritis, common in Mediterranean ancestry.

features.name: rash on lower legs erysipelas like

diseases.name: PFAPA syndrome
diseases.description_md: Periodic Fever, Aphthous stomatitis, Pharyngitis, cervical Adenitis. Most common periodic-fever syndrome in children.

features.name: recurrent fever every 3 to 6 weeks in child
cervical lymph node enlargement during fever

diseases.name: Narcolepsy
diseases.description_md: Chronic neurological sleep disorder with overwhelming daytime sleepiness and disrupted REM regulation.

features.name: sudden muscle weakness with emotion cataplexy

diseases.name: Polycystic ovary syndrome
diseases.description_md: Hyperandrogenic anovulatory disorder of reproductive-age women, frequently with insulin resistance and metabolic features.

diseases.name: Endometriosis
diseases.description_md: Endometrial-like tissue outside the uterus causing chronic pelvic pain, painful periods, and infertility.

diseases.name: Gallstones (cholelithiasis)
diseases.description_md: Crystallized bile components in the gallbladder causing episodic right-upper-quadrant pain after fatty meals.

features.name: right upper quadrant pain after fatty meal

diseases.name: Gastroesophageal reflux disease
diseases.description_md: Recurrent reflux of stomach contents into the esophagus causing heartburn, regurgitation, and sometimes extra-esophageal symptoms.

diseases.name: Gastroparesis
diseases.description_md: Delayed stomach emptying without mechanical obstruction, often from autonomic dysfunction or diabetes.

features.name: vomiting undigested food hours after meal

diseases.name: Lyme disease
diseases.description_md: Tick-borne Borrelia infection with characteristic expanding rash and possible later joint, neurologic, and cardiac involvement.

features.name: expanding red bullseye rash erythema migrans

diseases.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
diseases.description_md: Recurrent upper airway collapse during sleep producing daytime sleepiness, witnessed apneas, and cardiometabolic risk.

features.name: witnessed pauses in breathing during sleep

diseases.name: Major depressive disorder
diseases.description_md: Persistent low mood with anhedonia, sleep/appetite changes, and impaired function.

diseases.name: Generalized anxiety disorder
diseases.description_md: Chronic excessive worry across multiple domains with somatic symptoms.

diseases.name: Functional neurologic disorder
diseases.description_md: Genuine neurological symptoms (weakness, tremor, non-epileptic seizures, sensory loss) inconsistent with structural disease.

features.name: sensory loss not following anatomic pattern

diseases.name: Post COVID-19 condition (long COVID)
diseases.description_md: Persistent symptoms more than 3 months after acute COVID-19 infection, often dysautonomic and cognitive.

diseases.name: Reactive hypoglycemia
diseases.description_md: Symptomatic low blood glucose 2-4 hours after a meal, with adrenergic and neuroglycopenic features.

diseases.name: Sarcoidosis
diseases.description_md: Multisystem granulomatous disease, classically pulmonary, but with skin, eye, joint, and cardiac involvement.
